verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents ways to test without live production traffic. Its MCP tooling lets you write transformation code and test it against sample events before deploying, and the Event Playground sends sample events to test the data flow without instrumentation. Neither is documented as an isolated sandbox environment or workspace separated from production destinations and data. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test workspace isolated from production, documentation that Event Playground traffic stays out of production destinations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
